questions.question: What is the greatest commandment according to Jesus?
options: Keep the Sabbath day and keep it holy
Honor your father and your mother always
Love the Lord your God with all your heart
Do not bear false witness against your neighbor
questions.answer: Love the Lord your God with all your heart
